sens_en: to go through, to connect, open
origine_fr: En bas, 辶, la marche ; dessus, 甬, qui donnait le son mais se lit yǒng. C'est atteindre, aller jusqu'au bout sans obstacle. De là « passer, communiquer ».
origine_en: Below, 辶, walking; on it, 甬, which gave the sound but is read yǒng. It means to reach, to go all the way without obstacle. Hence “to pass through, to connect”.

phrase.fr: Ici, les transports sont très pratiques.
phrase.en: Getting around here is very easy.
